exposure: doula care during labor and/or birth
outcome: labor complications (chorioamnionitis, shoulder dystocia, arrest of labor)
cohort: The study included 3055 eligible patients giving birth at a single safety-net teaching hospital between January 1 and December 31, 2022.
finding: Doula care provided through a shift-based hospital model was associated with a decreased cesarean birth rate despite increased labor complications, induction of labor, and oxytocin use.
mod_finding: Doula care provided through a shift-based hospital model was associated with a decreased cesarean birth rate.
